<observations>
Date: Apr 25, 2026
* 🔴 (07:12) User stated Asheville, NC house renovation budget is $28,000, preferring quartz countertops over marble.
* 🟡 (08:10) Agent evaluated demolition options; QuickRaze selected ($1,850).
* 🔴 (12:15) User ordered custom 2-door cabinets from Cabinetry Creations (10-yr finish / 5-yr hardware warranty).
* ✅ (14:30) User approved countertop sample and confirmed StoneEdge quartz slab order (21-day delivery).

Date: Apr 28, 2026
* 🔴 (08:45) User selected Harbor Plumbing for installation (3-day window starting May 5).
* 🔴 (11:10) User selected EcoStone Composite (40 sq ft) for backsplash.
* ✅ (12:15) User approved backsplash order; agent noted 2-week delivery window due to limited stock.
* 🔴 (13:00) User inquired about electrical permit requirements for island outlets.

Date: May 1, 2026
* 🔴 (15:00) User provided address for electrical permit; agent submitted request to city Planning Office (20-amp dedicated circuit).
* 🔴 (17:05) User selected “Arctic White” quartz from GranitePeak ($3,200); agent scheduled delivery for May 7.
* 🔴 (19:00) User confirmed 36-inch built-in refrigerator and requested stainless-steel dishwasher quote from BrightHome.

Date: May 4, 2026
* 🔴 (08:10) User added 24-inch pull-out pantry from CabinetCo ($1,150, 14-day lead time).
* ✅ (11:05) Agent ordered 200 light gray subway tiles from TileMosaic Co with 8% discount (delivery May 10).
* 🔴 (13:30) User confirmed under-cabinet LED strips and scheduled site visit for May 9 (09:00).
* 🔴 (15:00) User stated preference for matte black cabinet hardware over brushed brass.

Date: May 8, 2026
* 🔴 (08:05) User approved “Storm Cloud” quartz countertop option ($78/sq ft, StoneWorks).
* 🔴 (13:00) User selected FaucetPro "AquaFlow-2000" brushed nickel faucet ($210).
* ✅ (15:15) Agent booked PlumbRight senior tech Carlos Ramos for faucet installation on May 15.
* 🔴 (16:00) User inquired about early countertop sample delivery to job site.

Date: May 12, 2026
* 🟡 (07:15) Drywall demolition deadline noted as May 18.
* ✅ (12:30) Agent submitted purchase order to TileMasters for 450 sq ft matte ivory porcelain tiles (5% discount, delivery May 20-22).
* 🟢 (17:20) User noted electrician's name is Dale Okonkwo.
* 🔴 (18:05) User approved CabinetCraft walnut island cabinets ($4,200) and scheduled installation for the week of May 25.
</observations>

<current-task>
- Primary: Tracking ongoing kitchen renovation orders, permits, and installation schedules.
- Secondary: Waiting for user's next instructions regarding appliance quotes or project logistics.
</current-task>

<suggested-response>
The assistant should wait for the user to provide the next instruction regarding the kitchen renovation.
</suggested-response>
